The per diem Clinical Associate will provide patient care services on an as-needed basis at the Emergency Department at UCI Health – Los Alamitos with the potential to work at other sites in the future. Clinical Associate is expected to comply with all compliance standards, complete all required trainings, and follow proper documentation process to meet the standards of the Compliance Office and Medicare regulations.
UCI Health - Los Alamitos
Active and current Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) certiﬁcation
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, and objectives while in compliance of all UC policies and procedures.
Maintain patient conﬁdentiality and comply with all state and federal privacy laws.
Schedule: Per diem, as needed based on departmental staffing needs. No guaranteed hours.
Leadership skills: ability to motivate, inspire, communicate with patients, families, staff, faculty, and peers to maintain a professional, team-based approach in the care of patients.
